name: International Hellenic University
summary: Public university with campuses in Thessaloniki, Serres, Katerini and Kilkis; bachelor's degrees are Greek-taught, English is at master's level.

ib.text: EU citizen with the IB: apply in the Ministry's foreign-school graduates category (one parent not of Greek origin, last two school years abroad); no exam, ranked on certificate grade; Greek B2 needed to enrol.

lastYear.text: apply online 2–9 July; courier postmark by 10 July

apply.via: Ministry of Education form for foreign-school graduates

notes: Its English-only UCIPS school has no bachelor's yet: the page says it "is planning to launch the first Bachelor program taught exclusively in English" and gives no date.
Only its two UCIPS schools teach in English, and their programmes are master's degrees; the regular undergraduate departments are listed without an English-taught option.
